name: Structured Field Extraction
description: Extract a specific field from a short unstructured record (invoices, tickets, shipping notes). Answers are short and exact, so deterministic correctness is highly reliable here.

default_config.system_prompt: Extract the requested field from the record. Reply with the value only — no explanation, no units unless they appear in the record, no punctuation beyond what the value contains.

metric_notes.correctness: Exact-match style task — the deterministic evaluator is a strong signal and no judge is needed.
metric_notes.faithfulness: Catches values invented when the field is genuinely absent.
metric_notes.latency: Extraction usually runs in bulk, so per-record latency compounds.
